title: Skip racing a concurrent viewed-trigger returns 200 'skipped: True' while the slot is actually queued
detail: do_skip's None-branch insert conflicts with a queued row committed by a concurrent viewed-trigger (queued is live for idx_reference_call_live). 0 rows yields Ok(Nil) and the handler returns 200 skipped=True, but the slot is queued and the sweep will contact the referee. Landlord's exclusion is silently lost.
recommended_fix: On 0-row insert, re-read the slot's live status; if it is anything other than 'skipped', return a branded 409 'This reference changed state. Refresh and try again.' instead of 200.

title: find_live_row_for_slot swallows list-query errors as None, pushing do_skip down the wrong branch
detail: A transient DB error on list_reference_calls_for_application is conflated with 'no live row'. do_skip then enters create_skipped_slot; if a queued row actually exists, the ON CONFLICT yields the misleading 200 described above rather than surfacing the read failure.
recommended_fix: Propagate the QueryError up and have do_skip return a branded 500 when the list query fails, mirroring the get_application_reference_data Error branch already in do_skip.

title: find_skipped_row_for_slot swallows list-query errors as None, making do_re_enable return a wrong 404
detail: A transient DB error on list_reference_calls_for_application is conflated with 'no skipped row'. do_re_enable then returns 404 'This reference isn't skipped.' even though a skipped row exists, so the landlord sees incorrect state (retriable, but wrong).
recommended_fix: Propagate the QueryError and have do_re_enable return a branded 500 when the list query fails, instead of the unchecked None-to-404 path.
